title: Playback Capability Profile And Rendition Planning
problem: Nako has a profile-driven playback planner, but selected playback output is still named as execution and duplicated across `PlaybackDecision` fields while `PlaybackProfile` keeps a shallow second identity format.

evidence.summary: Opened the playback capability profile and rendition planning refactor lane, selected the behavior-preserving rendition boundary slice, and accepted deletion of the shallow PlaybackProfile adapter.

Replaced PlaybackDecision.execution with PlaybackDecision.rendition, added PlaybackRenditionPlan and TranscodeRenditionPlan, and moved direct/remux/transcode/denied output intent under the rendition boundary.
Deleted PlaybackProfile and moved remux/HLS transcode profile construction, output constraints, track selection, and request-key identity to PlaybackTargetProfile.
Verified planner, Public Client redaction, and server playback gates, updated ADR 0044, and closed the workstream.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-28. Follow-on feature work such as adaptive HLS, fMP4, DLNA device profiles, subtitle/HDR execution, rsmpeg, or remote workers should open separate lanes.
